text:
rachel: FYI post-deploy smoke looking odd for short prompts on /generate — probe failures up and p95 doubled on canary (10% traffic). holding ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: rolling v3.0.0 -> v3.0.1 at 1750012200, canary 10%. smoke probes began 1750012250. failing probes: 18/120, mostly short prompt truncation/errors.

qa-bot: failing tests: short-prompt-trim, tokenizer-boundary-check. sample failing payloads attached to pipeline run 3aa8f6.

sean: we landed a tokenizer tweak in the model package (tokenizer_v2) as part of the minor release  earlier. that could explain short prompt behavior. no quant or serving kernel changes.

rachel: ok, if it's tokenizer_v2 that's likely. prefer toggling back to tokenizer_v1 via runtime feature flag rather than full rollback immediately. reduces blast radius.

tom: agreed. we have a runtime flag: features.tokenizer=\"v1\"/\"v2\" exposed in config service. i can flip it and do a targeted synth run on canary. will do a gradual config patch (canary-only).

infra-bot: note: config change will propagate via config-dispatcher, expected < 60s to reach edge runtime instances. metrics show config-sync healthy.

rachel: plan: 1) flip tokenizer -> v1 on canary 2) run focused synth set (short prompt suite) for 8m 3) if failures drop to baseline (<0.5%) resume ramp; else pin to v3.0.0 and schedule rollback window.

tom: performing patch now:
```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/overrides
-H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" 
-d '{"scope":"canary","features":{"tokenizer":"v1"}}'
```
Executing at 1750012500.

deploy-bot: config patch accepted (tx 8c7b2). restarting short-probe runners 1750012525 -> collecting 30 samples/min.

qa-bot: focused synth started 1750012530, suite=short-prompts-v2, expected baseline failure ~1/200. current failing rate 2.1% (5/240) at sample 4m.

sean: curious. if failures persist at ~2% might be data-dependent change in tokenizer mapping. can we dump token alignment for a few failing cases? (will share a quick script).

rachel: collect logs and token dumps but hold on full rollback for now. if by 1750013105 (8m after patch) we still >1% we pin and follow rollback playbook.

tom: logs and tokenization diffs uploaded to /tmp/release-diffs/1750012345. posting pointer in release-notes channel after decision.

infra-bot: reminder: pinning traffic back to v3.0.0 can be done with routing pin: POST /api/v1/routing/pin {"route":"/generate","version":"v3.0.0","scope":"canary"} — needs ops-auth.

rachel: thanks. i'll keep this thread as single source for decision. alerting support and docs about possible customer-facing note if we end up rolling back.

qa-bot: 7m mark metrics: failures down to 0.6% (2/300), p95 trending toward baseline.

sean: looks promising. those remaining failures look like edge cases, maybe due to legacy prompts.

rachel: OK — green enough to resume gradual ramp to 30% after 10m observation. i'll update the rollout plan and mark hold released at 1750012805.

tom: releasing hold and resuming ramp. will keep alerting window open 30m.
